summary: Created skills/self-learn-planner/SKILL.md (matches self-learn-judge frontmatter+procedure style). Planner subagent skill: get_learnings+get_full_graph to see done/failed/in-flight; bounded deep-research only when it flips the decision; propose 1-3 MAX initiatives, each suggest_links+TaskCreate+add_dependency (context to done/verdict/note, blocking for true prereqs) so they wire in not orphan; "try alternatives" → problem→attempts→judge subtree per judge skill. Hard guardrails: never cancel/supersede in-flight, never dup open tasks (dedup first), STOP+defer if nothing worth doing, request_guidance for user-owned calls. READ-ONLY DRY-RUN against live graph (no mutations): graph is NOT drained (4 ready/in_progress) so planner would NOT fire on heartbeat; verdicts empty, failures all "superseded" (not dead ends), open set is the concurrency+escalation+integration cluster. Correct behavior = take NO action / defer — proposing work now would collide with in-flight tasks. Skill correctly produces no-op. Written via ORCH_GATE_OFF=1 (edit gate can't see cross-process MCP claim). Uncommitted per increment-boundary policy.
